file_purpose: Evidence manifest for xevents. Append-only public mirror of the private-side manifest. One row per evidence artifact (hash + provenance). This file is boundary-writable per ADR 0012 §Boundary write set; the xevents-boundary[bot] GitHub App copies it across from xevents-internal on each publish per ADR 0014. See docs/data-model.md for the row schema and xevents-internal/docs/file-layout.md §JSONL header-row convention for the header contract.
